name: use-callback-ref
title: useCallbackRef
description: A custom hook that converts a callback to a ref to avoid triggering re-renders when passed as a prop or avoid re-executing effects when passed as a dependency

tags.type: - A function type that accepts any arguments and returns any value.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: - The callback function to store in a ref. It can be undefined.

returnType.name: T
returnType.description: T A stable function reference that always calls the latest callback.
